# Davy Keith & Dora

- [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — Sibling of — [Dora](../character/dora.md) — twin sister · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At supper, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) acts rambunctiously and snatches Dora's cake, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to try teaching him gentlemanly manners. After supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed early in the west gable room while she takes [Dora](../character/dora.md) to sleep with her.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026)_

> After walking home through [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discover that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) claims not to know where she is. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully promises never to tell another lie after learning it is wrong, though he later argues to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in bed that [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) also lied to him about prayers.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and she eagerly plans a elaborate dinner for the occasion. She spends the following days busy with preparations and keeping the children in line for the big event.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P28](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0028), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P35](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), then visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea and reassures him about his imaginative nature. Upon returning home, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) say his prayers and mend his jealous feelings. Later, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting on how mature and handsome he has become.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P37](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss Lavendar, as well as the history of [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's family, while trying to manage Davy's poor table manners. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) so they can permanently stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

> After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) publish a mock newspaper note about Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe severe hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact predicted day, causing massive devastation to crops, trees, and windows. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, later learning of the damage around town, including the death of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), school pranks, and marriage until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughed herself out to the cellar hatch. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walked to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth, enjoying lunch, playing with echoes, and gathering wild strawberries.
>

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)_
